purpose: Teach: 下北沢/築地/吉祥寺/バルサ/ヘッジファンド/スピリチュアル/おっぱい/ハイビジョン

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、下北沢の古着屋ハマってたな
lines.en: Riku, you were really into those vintage shops in Shimokita, weren't you?
lines.style: Teasing lilt at the end. Conspiratorial, like she's caught him at something harmless. Quick, sharp rhythm. Eyes bright.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、築地で食べ歩きしたな、桜
lines.en: Oh, and you were food-hopping through Tsukiji, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry mirror-back. Light, cool delivery. Slight smile underneath. The rhythm matches hers beat for beat.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、吉祥寺で美術館行ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, didn't you go to that art museum in Kichijoji?
lines.style: Pressing forward gently. Curious, testing. The lift at the end is genuine — she actually wants to know if he remembers.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、バルサのユニフォーム着てたな、桜
lines.en: You were wearing a Barcelona kit, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet counter-strike. Cool and unbothered on the surface. Underneath: he noticed, and he's letting her know he noticed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会でヘッジファンド習ったろ?
lines.en: Riku, you learned about hedge funds in your econ class, right?
lines.style: Lighter now, almost laughing at the randomness. She knows this detail matters to him. Curious but not pushy.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、スピリチュアルな占い本買ってたな、桜
lines.en: You bought that spiritual fortune-telling book, Sakura.
lines.style: Even drier now. The smallest smile in the voice. He's catalogued her contradictions like she's cataloguing his. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、弟がおっぱい飲んでた頃の話してたな
lines.en: Riku, you were telling me about when your little brother was still nursing.
lines.style: Softer now. The teasing edges gone. This one matters. Genuine memory, genuine warmth. No rush.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前ん家、ハイビジョンTV古いな、桜
lines.en: Your family's TV is ancient, Sakura.
lines.style: Quieter, almost tender. The wryness has softened into something closer to affection. Settling in. Not looking away.
